== Jumps.plainReturn (line 3)
| plainReturn(a)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      jump
        | return
    -
  call
    | work()

== Jumps.loops (line 10)
| loops(values)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=TRAVERSAL
    | foreach v in values
    -
      alternative
        | v < 0?
        -
          instruction color=ff0000 disabled
            | continue;
        -
      alternative
        | v > 100?
        -
          jump
            | break
        -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + v
  jump
    | return sum
! line 14: Continue

== Jumps.fail (line 24)
| fail(message)
  jump
    | throw new IllegalStateException(message)

== Jumps.work (line 29)
| work()
